# Released binary qrels reader source

`util.py` and `LICENSE.txt` are exact members of the official PyPI ir_measures 0.4.3 wheel (61,311 bytes). Complete wheel provenance, exact source hashes and two executed definition hashes are pinned in `pins.json`. The upstream Apache 2.0 license is retained. The wheel was read and hash-verified during qualification; it is not installed or vendored as an archive.

Only the unchanged `Qrel` and `read_trec_qrels` AST definitions execute, with Python standard-library dependencies, against a bounded actual local file. Full package initialization and all other utility definitions remain unexecuted attribution source. This is source-loaded external parser evidence, not full installed-package or evaluation compatibility. It retains signed integer qrels values; Tuldok independently validates the closed binary profile before parsing.
